tutorials.title: Wayfarer's Proving Guide
steps: Use the Action Cards on the Story screen to talk to NPCs, search hidden spots, interact with chests or shrines, and enter combat.
Open the World Map tab to zoom, pan, and travel between connected locations. Golden (!) pips mark active quest destinations.
Open Inventory to equip weapons, armor, shields, and rings/jewelry, consume rations or salves, and combine items (such as honing a spear with a whetstone).
Open Craft & Forge to practice concealed crafting: choose a category and two primary materials to discover what you forge.
Open Character to view your stats, skills, feats, and Grimoire spells as you earn Proving XP.
